deed: אדיטל אלע הקימה חברה ישראלית שמייצרת חומרי בנייה דלי-פחמן ממינרלים ממוחזרים
title: Adital Ela founded Criaterra in Holon: unfired earth wall tiles, in more than 150 projects

trailer.text: Adital Ela is an Israeli expert in industrial design and sustainability who created Criaterra, a women-led company.
In India she saw a chai cup made of sun-dried clay, which the stall owners collected after use and tossed back into the ground.
Ela said this experience gave rise to the idea of establishing a factory following the same ecological model.
According to Start-Up Nation Central, she founded the company in May 2015, and it is located in Holon.
In 2021 it was reported that the company produces from clay, sand, silt and vegetal fibers, without high temperatures, at 100 degrees Celsius.
According to the 2025 profile, its wall tiles have been installed in over 150 projects.

paragraphs.text: According to sponsored content in Haaretz, the idea for the company began about 25 years ago.

According to the article, Ela, then a graduate of a master's program in sustainable and industrial design at the Design Academy in the Netherlands, went to India to research traditional and ecological methods of producing materials.
According to the same content, she went to India to research traditional, ecological methods of producing materials.
In India she saw a chai cup made of sun-dried clay.
After use, the stall owners collected the cup and tossed it back into the ground.
Ela said this experience sparked her curiosity as a designer.
From it the idea was born to establish a factory following the same ecological model.
According to Ela, the built environment is the highest-emitting sector.
According to Ela, 8% of global emissions come from cement, the binder used to make concrete.
She said the cement industry consumes vast amounts of fossil fuels.
According to Ela, cement-based products offer little insulation, so a lot of energy is needed to keep the temperature comfortable.
In 2021 Calcalist CTech reported that cementitious materials are fired in kilns at 1,200 degrees and above, using fossil fuels.
According to the article, after firing they cannot be recycled or returned to the Earth.
According to sponsored content in Haaretz, ceramics and cement are fired at 1,200–1,600 degrees and release large amounts of carbon.
In 2023 Ela told CTech that Criaterra was founded to address the four-gigaton problem of cement as a building material.
According to sponsored content in Haaretz, the company was founded to meet the need for low-carbon building materials.
According to Start-Up Nation Central, Adital Ela founded Criaterra Innovations in May 2015.
According to the profile, the company has 1–10 employees.
Its address: 14 HaMashbir Street, Holon.
In 2021 the company was based in the industrial area of Holon, where it had an R&D laboratory and a pilot production plant.
According to sponsored content in Haaretz from 2025, the plant in Holon produces tiles for interior walls.
In 2021 Calcalist CTech described it as a female-led Israeli startup.
Ela describes herself as an industrial designer and impact-driven entrepreneur.
According to a Times of Israel blog, she has 25 years of experience in research and development at the intersection of sustainability, technology and design.
In 2021 the company's chair, Dafna Weiner, said the industry is ready for disruption and that it holds tremendous financial and environmental opportunities.
In 2021 it was reported that Criaterra uses clay, sand and silt, and combines them with vegetal fibers.
According to sponsored content in Haaretz, most of the raw materials are local, and many of them are reclaimed from infrastructure works or quarries.
According to CTech, the material is produced at 100 degrees Celsius, without high temperatures.
In 2023 Ela said the products are produced without going beyond the boiling point of water.
According to Ela, the carbonates remain in the raw materials, so process emissions drop to zero.
According to the Israel Innovation Authority, the products are based on patented Bio-Geo Agglomerated Stone, and are cement-free.
According to the Authority, building blocks and precast products (cast in advance) can be manufactured this way using fully renewable energy.
According to Unreasonable Group, the company has 4 patents: the first approved in the USA, Europe and Israel, and three in the PCT stage.
In 2021 it was reported that the company claims its products are fully recyclable.
According to Start-Up Nation Central, the technology reduces energy consumption by up to 90%.
According to sponsored content in Haaretz, the energy saving during the production stages is approximately 90%.
According to the Israel Innovation Authority, the products mitigate combustion emissions, process emissions and operational emissions.
According to the Israel Innovation Authority, the products have concrete strength and 6 times the insulation.
According to Ela, Criaterra masonry blocks are six times more insulative than concrete blocks.
In 2021, CTech reported that some of the products have thermal resistance (insulation) four times higher than that of ceramic.
According to sponsored content in Haaretz, the tiles award green building points and meet LEED standards.
According to an Unreasonable Group summary, after five years of R&D and extensive testing, the materials meet construction standards.
In 2021 it was reported that the products had been installed in office buildings in Israel, including buildings designed by the Tidhar Group.
They were also installed in ten Bank Hapoalim branches.
According to Ela, tiles were installed in the dining room of the Dan Panorama Hotel in Tel Aviv.
According to Ela, the tiles also reached other countries.
They were installed in a wellness center in London, and in an eco-hotel and a café in the Netherlands.
They were also installed in the innovation center of Sino Group in Hong Kong.
According to sponsored content in Haaretz, the projects include industrial buildings, commercial centers, hotels, and sports and leisure centers.
According to Ela, securing financing for R&D in this field has been a challenge.
She said she overcame it with the help of partners, expert validation and grants.
According to sponsored content in Haaretz, the technology was selected for funding by the Israel Innovation Authority and the European Union's Horizon program.
In 2021 it was reported that the company was completing a pre-seed round of $4.6 million from venture capital firms.
According to Start-Up Nation Central, the company has raised a total of $8.89 million across 7 rounds.
In 2021 the company was a finalist in the SBID International Design Awards for its zero-waste tile.
According to CTech, in 2023 it was one of five companies that reached the final round of the Israeli Climate Awards.
According to Unreasonable Group, Ela is an Unreasonable Fellow.
She took part in the Unreasonable Impact UK & Europe program between February and April 2022.
According to sponsored content in Haaretz, countries in Europe have set carbon quotas for contractors.
In the Netherlands enforcement is particularly strict, and many contractors are struggling to meet them.
According to Ela, a first license agreement has been signed and completed for manufacturing and selling the tiles in 4 countries in Europe.
According to sponsored content in Haaretz, the company has formed a partnership to establish a factory in Romania with a capacity of one million square meters per year.
According to the same content, it is establishing a new plant in Israel with a capacity of 100 thousand square meters per year.
In 2025 Ela said the company is setting up the world's first production lines for unfired interior tiles.
According to her, the next leap is automated industrial production with high capacity.
According to Start-Up Nation Central, the company planned a fully financed production line in the first quarter of 2026.

disagreements.question: In how many projects have the products been installed?

versions.says: Start-Up Nation Central profile from 2025: in more than 150 projects
Sponsored content in Haaretz from February 2025: nearly 200 projects

disagreements.question: By how much do the products reduce emissions?

versions.says: Calcalist CTech in 2021: the products emit only 20% of the CO2 in production
Ela to CTech in 2023: an 86% reduction in emissions
Ela, according to an EPD: global warming impact two thirds lower than competing products

disagreements.question: What share of global CO2 emissions is linked to construction?

versions.says: Sponsored content in Haaretz: approximately 40% of carbon emissions
Calcalist CTech in 2021: nearly two-thirds, indirectly
Ela in the blog: approximately 40% of CO2 emissions

disagreements.question: What happens to clay when it is fired, and who said so?

versions.says: CTech in 2021, citing Ela: clay becomes something similar to volcanic ash
Algemeiner in 2021, citing Weiner: clay becomes something similar to glass, and other minerals turn to ash

disagreements.question: How much non-dilutive funding was received from Europe?

versions.says: Calcalist CTech in 2021: $2.3 million (2 million euros) in non-dilutive or grant funding from the European Commission's Horizon Europe program.
Start-Up Nation Central: $2.77 million in March 2020, from the European Commission and the Israel Innovation Authority

disagreements.question: How many employees does Criaterra have?

It is not known whether the industrial production line planned for the first quarter of 2026 is in fact operating

claims.quote: The cup was made from sun-dried clay. After the customers finished their drinks, the shop owners collected the cups and tossed them back into the ground.

claims.quote: This experience sparked my designer's curiosity and the idea to establish a factory following the same ecological model was born

claims.text: לפי פרופיל Start-Up Nation Central (עודכן בפברואר 2025), קריאטרה אינובשנס הוקמה במאי 2015 על ידי אדיטל אלע ופעלה עם 1–10 עובדים.
claims.quote: Founded in May 2015 by Adital Ela, Criaterra Innovations operates with 1–10 employees.

claims.text: לפי פרופיל Start-Up Nation Central, מיקום החברה הוא חולון, רחוב המשביר 14.

claims.text: ב-2021 דווח שקריאטרה משתמשת באותם חומרי גלם טבעיים, חימר, חול וסחף, ומשלבת אותם בסיבים צמחיים.
claims.quote: Criaterra however is using the same natural materials - namely clay, sand, and silt - but combining them with natural vegetal fibers

claims.quote: create a composite material that can be produced without using high temperatures, at 100 degrees Celsius

claims.quote: with its first product, Criaterra wall tiles, already installed in over 150 projects.

claims.text: לפי הפרופיל, החברה גייסה עד אז בסך הכול 8.89 מיליון דולר ב-7 סבבי מימון.
claims.quote: The company has raised a total of $8.89M across 7 funding rounds.

claims.text: לפי כתבת CTech מאוגוסט 2023, קריאטרה הייתה אחת מחמש חברות קלימייט-טק שהגיעו לשלב הגמר בפרסי האקלים הישראליים שנערכו שבוע קודם.
claims.quote: Criaterra was one of five climate tech companies that made it to the final round of the Israeli Climate Awards last week.

claims.text: לפי תוכן שיווקי בהארץ מפברואר 2025, הרעיון להקמת החברה התחיל לפני כ-25 שנה.
claims.quote: The idea for the company began 25 years ago.

claims.text: לפי אותו תוכן, אלע, אז בוגרת תואר שני בעיצוב בר-קיימא ותעשייתי באקדמיה לעיצוב בהולנד, נסעה להודו לחקור שיטות מסורתיות ואקולוגיות לייצור חומרים.
claims.quote: Adital Ela, then a graduate of a master's program in Sustainable & Industrial design at the Design Academy in the Netherlands, went to India to research traditional ecological material production methods.

claims.quote: It is also the highest-emitting sector, with a share of approximately 40% of global CO2 emissions.

claims.quote: Of this number, 8% of global emissions are from cement, the binder used to make concrete.

claims.quote: These products contain cementitious products that are incinerated in kilns at very high temperatures of 1,200 degrees Celsius and above, requiring the use of fossil fuels.

claims.text: לפי הכתבה, החומרים שנשרפים כך אינם ניתנים למחזור או להחזרה לאדמה והופכים לתרכובות אחרות.
claims.quote: Those substances cannot be recycled or be returned to the Earth, and instead become different compounds.

claims.quote: Criaterra was founded in order to address the four gigaton problem of cement as a building material

claims.quote: given the fact that the global construction industry is responsible for approximately 40% of carbon emissions into the atmosphere

claims.quote: CRIATERRA's pilot production plant, which is also the R&D center, is located in Holon and produces tiles for interior walls.

claims.quote: The female-led Israeli startup, Criaterra Innovations, creates sustainable building materials to build office and residential buildings that can be recycled and later even reused.

claims.quote: She brought her 25 years of deep experience in research and development in the cross section of sustainability, technology and design to create beautiful solutions.

claims.quote: Criaterra’s patented Bio-Geo Agglomerated Stone low carbon, cement-free precast products for construction have concrete strength and 6x the insulation

claims.quote: These tiles are produced at low temperatures using an innovative method that reduces approximately 90% of the energy required during the production stages.

claims.quote: mitigating 3 emissions sources: combustion emissions, process emissions and operational emissions

claims.text: לפי אלע, גיוס מימון למו"פ בקטגוריית המוצרים של החברה היה אתגר, והיא התגברה עליו בעזרת שותפים, אימות מומחים ומענקים.
claims.quote: This development is a long-term project and securing financing for R&D in our product category has been a challenge.

claims.text: לפי תוכן שיווקי בהארץ, הטכנולוגיה נבחרה למימון מרשות החדשנות ומתוכנית Horizon של האיחוד האירופי.
claims.quote: This innovative technology was selected for funding from Israel Innovation Authority and the European Union's Horizon program.

claims.text: ב-2021 דווח שהחברה בתהליך השלמת סבב פרה-סיד של 4.6 מיליון דולר (4 מיליון אירו) מקרנות הון סיכון.
claims.quote: Criaterra is also in the process of completing a pre-seed financing round of $4.6 million (4 million euros) from venture capital firms.

claims.text: ב-2021 דווח שהחברה הייתה פיינליסטית בפרסי SBID International Design Awards 2021 בקטגוריית משטחים וגימורים על האריח נטול הפסולת שלה.
claims.quote: the company was featured as a finalist for the 2021 SBID International Design Awards in the Surfaces & Finishes category for its zero-waste tile

claims.text: לפי Unreasonable Group, אדיטל אלע היא Unreasonable Fellow.
claims.quote: Adital is an Unreasonable Fellow. Adital was part of

claims.text: לפי הפרופיל, אלע השתתפה בתוכנית Unreasonable Impact UK & Europe בין פברואר לאפריל 2022.
claims.quote: Unreasonable Impact UK & Europe 2022 (Feb - Apr)

claims.text: לפי תוכן שיווקי בהארץ, מדינות באירופה הציבו מכסות פחמן לקבלנים, ובהולנד האכיפה מחמירה במיוחד וקבלנים רבים מתקשים לעמוד בהן.
claims.quote: In the Netherlands, for instance, enforcement is particularly strict, and many contractors are struggling to work within these quotas.

claims.text: לפי אלע, נחתם והושלם הסכם רישיון ומסחור ראשון לייצור ומכירת אריחי קריאטרה ב-4 מדינות באירופה.
claims.quote: Our first license and commercialization agreement has been signed and completed, for manufacturing and selling Criaterra tiles in 4 countries in Europe.

claims.text: לפי תוכן שיווקי בהארץ, החברה יצרה שותפות אירופית להקמת מפעל תעשייתי ברומניה בתפוקה של מיליון מ"ר בשנה.
claims.quote: The company has formed a European partnership to establish an industrial factory in Romania with a production capacity of one million square meters per year.

claims.text: לפי אותו תוכן, החברה מקימה מפעל חדש בישראל בתפוקה של 100 אלף מ"ר בשנה.
claims.quote: In addition, the company is establishing a new plant in Israel with a capacity of 100,000 square meters per year.

claims.text: ב-2025 אמרה אלע שהחברה מקימה כעת את קווי הייצור הראשונים בעולם לאריחי פנים שאינם נשרפים.
claims.quote: We are currently setting up the world's first production lines for unfired interior tiles

claims.text: ב-2025 אמרה אלע שהקפיצה הבאה היא מעבר לייצור תעשייתי אוטומטי ולתפוקה גבוהה.
claims.quote: Our next big leap will be transitioning to automated industrial production and achieving high production capacity.

claims.text: לפי פרופיל שעודכן בפברואר 2025, החברה תכננה להגיע לייצור בקנה מידה תעשייתי דרך קו ייצור ממומן במלואו ברבעון הראשון של 2026.
claims.quote: plans to reach industrial-scale production of its BioGeo Agglomerated Stone technology through a fully financed manufacturing line in Q1 2026

claims.text: לפי דף הפרויקט של Unreasonable Group, לחברה יש מעל 150 פרויקטים מסחריים, וייצור ברישיון והרחבת הייצור נמצאים בעיצומם.
claims.quote: 150+ commercial projects; licensed production and scale-up underway

claims.text: ב-2023 אמרה אלע ל-CTech שהמוצרים מיוצרים תוך חיסכון של 90% באנרגיה והפחתה של 86% בפליטות.
claims.quote: yet are produced while saving 90% more energy and [reducing] 86% of emissions.

claims.text: לפי אלע, תצהיר סביבתי למוצר (EPD) הראה שההשפעה על ההתחממות הגלובלית של המוצר הראשון נמוכה בשני שלישים ממוצרים מתחרים, אפילו באתר ייצור קטן.
claims.quote: proving that it is already two thirds lower than competing products, even at a small-scale production site.

claims.text: ב-2021 דיווח כלכליסט CTech, בהסתמך על נתונים עדכניים, שכמעט שני שלישים מפליטות ה-CO2 נגרמים בעקיפין מבנייה.
claims.quote: According to recent data, nearly two-thirds of CO2 emissions are indirectly caused by construction.

claims.text: בכתבת CTech מ-2021 צוטטה אלע באומרה שבשריפה חימר הופך למשהו דומה לאפר וולקני.
claims.quote: Clay would become something similar to volcanic ash

claims.text: בפרסום החוזר באלגמיינר מ-2021 מיוחס הציטוט שבשריפה חימר הופך למשהו דומה לזכוכית, ושמינרלים אחרים הופכים לאפר, לוויינר ולא לאלע.
claims.quote: Clay would become something similar to glass,” said Weiner, while other minerals would simply turn to ash.

claims.text: ב-2021 דיווח כלכליסט CTech שהחברה קיבלה 2.3 מיליון דולר (2 מיליון אירו) במימון לא מדלל או מענקים מתוכנית Horizon Europe של הנציבות האירופית.
claims.quote: Currently, Criaterra has received $2.3 million (2 million euros) in non-dilutive or grant funding from the European Commission’s Horizon Europe program

claims.text: לפי פרופיל Start-Up Nation Central, במרץ 2020 נרשם מימון לא מניבני של 2.77 מיליון דולר מהנציבות האירופית ורשות החדשנות.
claims.quote: Mar 2020 | nonequity | $2.77M | European Commission, Israel Innovation Authority

claims.quote: the company hopes to open an industrial plant in Europe in 2022
